patch.summary: Attio cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Attio pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Trial/free path present in researched plans

blocks.title: Attio plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · up to 3 seats · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Plus
lines.description: up to 10 seats · Unlocks: AI assistance · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Pro
lines.description: Unlocks: forecasting · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.heading: Attio cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Attio against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (forecasting (Pro, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, lead management, pipeline management) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Confirm live Attio checkout; packaging can change.. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
